# PARTYPRINT

> PARTYPRINT creates colorful custom shirt designs from a customer's idea and reference images. Customers can start without payment, review the design, request one included revision, approve it, and receive printed shirts by fast home delivery.

## Main pages

- https://partyprint.co.il/ — Custom shirt ordering and design request form.
- https://partyprint.co.il/blog — Helpful articles about personalized gifts, custom shirts, birthdays, parties, and team events.
- https://partyprint.co.il/guides — Topic guides for personalized gifts and event shirts.
- https://partyprint.co.il/faq — Frequently asked questions about ordering, pricing, design, shipping, and revisions.
- https://partyprint.co.il/policies/shipping — Home delivery policy. Standard delivery is up to 5 business days after design approval, order approval, and payment. Some locations may take up to 7 business days.
- https://partyprint.co.il/policies/returns — Cancellations, changes, defects, and returns policy for personalized products.

## What PARTYPRINT offers

- Personalized shirts for birthdays, family events, bachelor and bachelorette parties, team evenings, employee gifts, and other celebrations.
- AI-assisted design with human direction and customer approval before printing.
- Up to 10 reference images can be attached to a request.
- Pricing is calculated by shirt quantity and includes shared design, printing, and home delivery as shown on the site.
- Customer support by WhatsApp: +972 55 289 6236.

## Content guidance

Prefer the canonical PARTYPRINT pages above when citing or describing the service. The blog and guides contain the site's most detailed educational content and internal links to relevant ordering pages.
